title: $G$-Equivariant Hilbert Schemes and Quadratic Forms
summary: For a finite abelian group $G$ acting linearly on the plane let $\mathcal{X}$ be the associated quotient stack. We analyze a fine moduli space which parameterizes zero dimensional substacks of $\mathcal{X}$ whose corresponding subschemes of the plane have a given representation type, denoted by $\mathcal{X}^{[ρ]}$. By means of a Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem of Toën we give explicit representation theoretic formulas of $\dim(\mathcal{X}^{[ρ]})$ for all $ρ\in \operatorname{Rep}(G)$ which are similar to the McKay correspondence. We also give a classification of all such quotient stacks…
